step.title: On a phone
step.body: Every page is dark with the frosted menu strip, and the Featured video autoplays on iOS: the attributes a phone needs are set on every film, with a first-touch fallback for Low Power Mode. The responsive pass went down to small phones at 390px.
step.source: README v2 (frosted menu strip, autoplay on iOS, responsive pass), CLAUDE.md (Autoplay)
